# Adversarial Source/PIT Readiness Review — Q202-Q204 + Q205
**Task:** AI-2026-10-04-GLOBAL-ADVERSARIAL-SOURCE-PIT  
**Role:** Independent adversarial second opinion (worker material only)  
**Standard:** Grok Q194-Q201 review extended to information-timing family (Q202-Q204) and NLRB channel (Q205)  
**Status:** REVIEW_COMPLETE_ON_EMBEDDED_ARTIFACTS — no live probes, no performance claims

---

## 1. Executive Finding
**All Q202-Q204 and Q205 source/PIT readiness is PROVISIONAL_LIVE_PROBE_ONLY.**  
No candidate in this family is bound to an immutable dated snapshot/vintage or explicitly frozen historical artifact. The `orthogonal_pit_next_gate.py` compiler correctly emits `IMMUTABLE_HISTORICAL_SNAPSHOT_REQUIRED_BEFORE_PIT` for Q202, Q203, Q204. Q205 has no receipt at all — it is discovery-only and correctly quarantined.

---

## 2. Attack Surface by Failure Mode

### (1) Current-Endpoint Drift & Retrospective Source-Readiness Changes
| Candidate | Evidence of Drift Risk | Missing Durable Artifact |
|-----------|------------------------|--------------------------|
| **Q202** (SEC filing-arrival latency) | SEC EDGAR modern API endpoints, RSS feeds, and bulk-index files change schema, rate limits, and historical depth without versioned archives. A "current probe" of `https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/daily-index/` proves nothing about 2020-2024 availability. | **Dated SEC EDGAR daily-index snapshot bundle** (e.g., `edgar-daily-index-20200101-20241231.tar.gz.sha256`) with immutable fingerprint, or an explicit frozen historical artifact (Internet Archive WARC, AWS Open Data snapshot, or vendor vintage). |
| **Q203** (13F/N-PORT ownership transitions) | SEC 13F/N-PORT bulk data API (`https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/`) has no SLA on historical completeness. Filing amendments (13F-HR/A, N-PORT/A) can retroactively change holdings. | **Versioned 13F/N-PORT amendment lineage archive** with per-filing `accession_number → [amendment_sequence, acceptance_datetime, sha256]` mapping, frozen before any trial universe construction. |
| **Q204** (XBRL fundamental-change states) | XBRL taxonomy versions (US-GAAP 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) change element definitions. A current XBRL parser on historical filings produces anachronistic tags. | **Per-vintage XBRL taxonomy + instance document archive** (taxonomy zip + instance zips) with `sha256` manifest, or a vendor frozen vintage (e.g., Calcbench, XBRL US historical package) with explicit vintage date. |
| **Q205** (NLRB labor-representation certification) | NLRB public data portal (`https://www.nlrb.gov/case/`) has no bulk historical API. Case status changes (petition → election → certification → appeal) are mutable. Current search UI ≠ historical observation clock. | **NLRB case-event timeline snapshot** (petition_date, election_date, certification_date, appeal_disposition_date) for all cases in universe, frozen as CSV/Parquet with `sha256`, or an explicit FOIA-produced vintage. |

**Minimal deterministic falsifier for each:** Re-run the exact source-feasibility probe against a **time-travelled endpoint** (e.g., Wayback Machine snapshot of the SEC EDGAR index from 2022-01-01). If the probe returns different schema/fields/completeness, the current probe is invalid as historical evidence.

---

### (2) Historical Observation/Publication Timestamps
| Candidate | Timestamp Deficiency | Required Clock Discipline |
|-----------|---------------------|---------------------------|
| **Q202** | SEC `acceptance_datetime` (Eastern Time, millisecond precision) is the only defensible public-observation clock. `filing_date` (date-only) and `period_of_report` are **not** observation boundaries. | Must use `acceptance_datetime` from the index.json or submission header. If only `filing_date` is available, the event clock **must** be next regular trading session open — no intraday inference. |
| **Q203** | 13F `signature_date` and `filing_date` are date-only. `acceptance_datetime` exists in the submission header but is often omitted in bulk extracts. | Must extract `acceptance_datetime` from each primary document (not the index). If unavailable, clock = next regular session after `filing_date`. |
| **Q204** | XBRL `contextRef` period end dates are reporting periods, not publication dates. The `acceptance_datetime` of the 10-K/10-Q is the observation clock. | Same as Q202: `acceptance_datetime` of the parent filing. XBRL parsing must be gated on filing acceptance, not period end. |
| **Q205** | NLRB publishes `case_closed_date` and `certification_date` as dates. No timestamp. Election results may be posted days after the count. | Clock = next regular trading session after the **earliest public posting** of the certification (requires NLRB docket scraping with HTTP `Last-Modified` or archive.org capture). |

**Minimal deterministic falsifier:** For a sample of 50 historical events per candidate, compare the claimed observation timestamp against an independent archive (Wayback Machine, SEC EDGAR log files, NLRB PDF docket timestamps). Any mismatch > 1 session = clock discipline failure.

---

### (3) Revision/Amendment/Correction/QC/Prosecution Lineage
| Candidate | Revision Risk | Missing Lineage Artifact |
|-----------|---------------|--------------------------|
| **Q202** | Filing amendments (10-K/A, 8-K/A) can change material content. SEC EDGAR does not guarantee amendment ordering in bulk indexes. | **Amendment chain per accession**: `accession_number → [parent_accession, amendment_number, acceptance_datetime, is_material_change]`, frozen. |
| **Q203** | 13F-HR/A and N-PORT/A filings restate holdings. N-PORT has monthly frequency with restatements. | **Holdings version graph**: `cik → [report_date, version_sequence, acceptance_datetime, holdings_hash]`, with material-change flag. |
| **Q204** | XBRL filings can be amended (10-K/A). Taxonomy updates can reclassify historical facts. | **XBRL fact versioning**: `cik → [filing_accession, element_name, fact_value, unit, decimals, context_hash, acceptance_datetime]`, per taxonomy vintage. |
| **Q205** | NLRB cases: petition → election → certification → appeal → remand → re-election. Each stage can overturn prior. | **Case event DAG**: `case_number → [event_type, event_date, event_outcome, supersedes_event_id]`, frozen at snapshot date. |

**Minimal deterministic falsifier:** Pick 20 amended filings/cases per candidate. Reconstruct the timeline using only the frozen lineage artifact. If the reconstructed public-observation sequence differs from the live API's current view, the lineage is incomplete.

---

### (4) Frozen Pre-Event Entity/Exposure Mappings
| Candidate | Mapping Drift Risk | Required Frozen Mapping |
|-----------|-------------------|-------------------------|
| **Q202** | CIK ↔ ticker mappings change (IPOs, delistings, ticker changes, mergers). A 2023 CIK→ticker map applied to 2020 filings creates look-ahead. | **Point-in-time CIK→ticker→exchange map** per month (or per filing date) with `effective_date`, `end_date`, `sha256`. |
| **Q203** | 13F filers (institutional managers) change CIKs, names, and advisory relationships. N-PORT series/fund identifiers change. | **Manager CIK → [fund_series_id, fund_name, ticker, cusip]** per report date, frozen. |
| **Q204** | Same as Q202 — issuer identity must be frozen at filing acceptance. | Same as Q202. |
| **Q205** | NLRB case `employer_name` ≠ public ticker. Employer may be subsidiary, private, or renamed. No standard identifier. | **Employer name → [legal_entity_id, ticker, cik, relationship_type, effective_date]** mapping, manually curated and frozen with `sha256`. |

**Minimal deterministic falsifier:** For each candidate, take the frozen mapping at snapshot date T. Apply it to events at T-6 months. Count mappings that resolve to a different entity than a T+6 months mapping. Any non-zero = mapping not frozen.

---

### (5) Same-Day/Date-Only Leakage
| Candidate | Leakage Vector | Mitigation Required |
|-----------|----------------|---------------------|
| **Q202** | If `acceptance_datetime` is 15:59 ET and market closes 16:00 ET, same-session reaction is leakage. | **Hard rule**: Event clock = next regular session open if `acceptance_datetime` ≥ 12:00 ET (conservative). Must prove no intraday signal used. |
| **Q203** | 13F filed 45 days after quarter-end. `filing_date` is often same as `acceptance_date` (date-only). | Clock = next regular session after `filing_date`. No same-quarter inference. |
